evidence.quote: Manage prescriptions for the whole family, submit refills, view prescription status, history, and more.
Get prescriptions automatically filled ahead of time and ready when you are.
Pharmacy Services to Support Your Health Needs
Merchants in this category specialize in selling prescription drugs and over-the-counter medicines, supplements, and various health-related items.
Drug Store purchases include those made at stand-alone drug stores, pharmacies, and online pharmacies.
Some grocery stores with gas stations (like Hy-Vee®, Kroger® or Meijer) may qualify for 2% cash back in the gas and/or grocery categories.
Pharmacies inside of other retail stores may not qualify.

draft.notes: The page is specifically for Hy-Vee Pharmacy and describes prescription fulfillment, making drugstores the best page-specific category. However, U.S. Bank describes Hy-Vee as a grocery store, and issuer exclusions indicate pharmacies inside other retail stores may not qualify; the exact merchant-code treatment is uncertain.
